sentences.text: 2 15-04-2024 Heard Mr. Sanjay Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioners and the State.

2. The present writ application has been preferred for the following relief/s:-
"i.

For issuance of an appropriate writ/s, order/s, Direction/s to the respondents to pay the amount of compensation as per MVR effective from Patna High Court CWJC No.17095 of 2023(2) dt.15-04-2024 2014-2015 and suitable compensation be paid @
Rs. 2,00,000/- per decimal minimum to the petitioner for their land since the State has realized the stamp duty on said amount at the time of registration of sale deed of the land in the name of wives of the petitioners on 16.07.2020 but vide notice dated 04.03.2023 only an amount of Rs. 4100/- per decimal is being paid to the petitioners Vijay Bahadur Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21302762/
1 treating the land to be agricultural land whereas it is commercial in nature.

entities.text: Vijay Bahadur Singh vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: ii. For issuance of an appropriate writ/s, order/s, Direction/s to the respondents for payment of compensation to the petitioner for acquirement of their land as per Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act, 2013, commensurate to the amount realized by the State as stamp duty at the time of registration of sale deed as treating the land to be commercial in nature and as per the Patna High Court CWJC No.17095 of 2023(2) dt.15-04-2024 M.V.R. prevalent w.e.f. 2014-2015 alongwith interest to the petitioners.

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
iii. For issuance of an appropriate writ/s, order/s, Direction/s to the respondents not to force the petitioners to accept the meager amount which has been fixed as per the award given by the Collector of the district erroneously vide award case no.
08/2023-24 though in the notice under section 37(2) issued to the petitioners in exercise of power given under section 23 and 30 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act, 2013 but the amount of compensation has been calculated as per the whims of the respondent Circle Officer and District Land Acquisition Officer.
iv. To pass such other order/orders as your Lordships may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of this case."

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the Patna High Court CWJC No.17095 of 2023(2) dt.15-04-2024 petitioners will be approaching the Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority within four weeks from today.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the respondents has no objection to it.
5. The writ petition stands disposed of granting liberty to the petitioners to move before 'the Authority' as incorporated above.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Adnan/-
